verifiedAttributes.safety: SafePlus Engineering: automotive-grade high-strength steel anti-rebound bar, premium/rigid LATCH connectors, EasyPath belt lock-off, side-impact protection, required top-tether, 2-position leveling foot + bubble indicators, UPF 50+ canopy; 4-30 lb / up to 30"
verifiedAttributes.bobWayfinderAdapter: none — the Diono LiteClik 30 is NOT on the BOB Wayfinder adapter compatibility list (Wayfinder universal adapter covers only Britax ClickTight, Nuna, Cybex, Maxi-Cosi).
verifiedAttributes.bobAlterrainAdapter: BOB Gear Single Infant Car Seat Adapter for Nuna/Cybex/Maxi-Cosi — $99.99. The LiteClik 30 uses the Maxi-Cosi footprint, and Strolleria lists the LiteClik 30 RX/RXT/XT SafePlus as Alterrain/Alterrain Pro compatible with an adapter.
verifiedAttributes.tacomaFitNotes: No direct data found for the LiteClik 30 in a Tacoma. (Diono's strong Tacoma reputation is for its Radian convertibles' narrow 3-across footprint, not the LiteClik 30 infant seat.) General CPST guidance: rear-facing infant seats fit a Tacoma Access/Double Cab rear seat with the front passenger seat slid forward; Regular Cab is not rated for rear-facing.

notes: KEY VERIFICATION (plan asked to confirm Diono on BOTH BOB lists): it is NOT on both. The LiteClik 30 appears ONLY on the BOB Alterrain/Alterrain Pro list (via a $99.99 Maxi-Cosi-footprint BOB adapter); it is NOT on the BOB Wayfinder adapter compatibility list. Recommend integration set fitsWayfinder=false (stub currently true); fitsAlterrain stays true (with adapter, not native). Carrier-only weight: base 'R' model = 9 lb (✓ matches stub; carrierLbVerify can be cleared); heavier trims XT 10.4 lb / RXT 10.6 lb. Variants: R (steel anti-rebound bar), RX/RXT (+3-pos no-rethread harness & full canopy), XT/RXT (extended). Widely OUT OF STOCK across Diono DTC and boutiques as of 2026-06; on-sale prices ranged $174.99-$209.99. Keep price:250 as MSRP fallback per SOURCING.md.
